items.t: Newmont (NEM) Stock Looks Reasonable Following Its 252% Three Year Run
items.sum: Newmont has logged striking share gains in recent years, and the question now is whether the current US$119.96 price is properly grounded in the cash the miner can generate. After a run like this, valuation arguments tend to get louder than usual. Newmont has returned 252.2% over the past 3 years, which puts a lot of pressure on the underlying cash flows to justify that kind of move. Recent report

items.t: Will Higher Unit Costs Weigh on Newmont's Margins in Q4?
items.sum: Newmont's Q3 gold CAS rose 22% to $1,449 per ounce, while co-product AISC climbed 25%.

items.t: Newmont Stock Up 26% YTD: Should You Buy, Sell or Hold the Stock?
items.sum: NEM's 26% YTD gain reflects strong cash flows, higher gold prices and growth projects, but declining production and rising costs warrant caution.

items.t: Why Is Newmont Stock Falling on Tuesday?
items.sum: Why is Newmont (NYSE: NEM) stock falling today? Gold fell below $4,060 an ounce after hotter US inflation data and Fed Governor Waller’s rate hike remarks.
